answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every agent hold a bond tied to its work history, like tending an orchard - each identity must accumulate peer attestations season by season before it earns full rights, so a gale of freshly minted fake agents arrives with zero fruit and gains nothing. Peers carry a lantern - a public ledger trail of past attestations - so clones and copycats are spotted instantly and their bond is slashed, making mass identity creation a net loss instead of a profitable flood.
